scope: Every event Claude Code accepts in settings.json.

events.name: Setup
events.reason: one-time environment preparation before a session exists; there is no session to bind evidence to

events.name: UserPromptExpansion
events.reason: reports prompt text after expansion; the submitted prompt is already observed through UserPromptSubmit

events.name: PostToolBatch
events.reason: aggregates calls already observed individually through PostToolUse

events.name: MessageDisplay
events.reason: presentation of model output; carries no decision Reconc can make and no evidence it can attribute to an agent session

events.name: TaskCreated
events.reason: host task bookkeeping unrelated to repository policy

events.name: TaskCompleted
events.reason: host task bookkeeping unrelated to repository policy

events.name: TeammateIdle
events.reason: multi-agent presence signal; Stop already gates completion

events.name: InstructionsLoaded
events.reason: reports which instruction files the host read; carries no decision Reconc can make and no evidence it can attribute to an agent session

events.name: ConfigChange
events.reason: host configuration change; carries no decision Reconc can make and no evidence it can attribute to an agent session

events.name: CwdChanged
events.reason: working-directory change; repository identity is resolved per event instead

events.name: DirectoryAdded
events.reason: workspace directory addition; carries no decision Reconc can make and no evidence it can attribute to an agent session

events.name: FileChanged
events.reason: reports mutations from any source, including the user's own editor, so it cannot establish that an agent session wrote a path

events.name: WorktreeCreate
events.reason: host worktree bookkeeping; repository identity is resolved per event instead

events.name: WorktreeRemove
events.reason: host worktree bookkeeping; repository identity is resolved per event instead

events.name: Elicitation
events.reason: interactive prompt to the user; carries no decision Reconc can make and no evidence it can attribute to an agent session

events.name: ElicitationResult
events.reason: the user's answer to an interactive prompt; carries no decision Reconc can make and no evidence it can attribute to an agent session
